players.product: vacuum pumps and exhaust abatement systems for semiconductor fabs (Vacuum Technique business area)

quarterly_data.quarter: Atlas Copco IR presentation: quarterly report (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 quarterly report, Vacuum Technique: orders received MSEK 16 659 (8 916), +87%; revenues a record MSEK 12 257 (9 193); operating profit a record MSEK 2 726 (1 697); nine-month orders MSEK 42 121 (27 355), +54%. Orders by region: Asia/Oceania 67%, North America 21%, Europe 11%, Africa/Middle East 1%. Semiconductor and flat panel display order volumes 'increased sharply to another record level', driven by several key accounts across all major regions, with tangible sequential growth driven by Asia; industrial and scientific vacuum orders also reached another record level. Equipment was 76% of Vacuum Technique revenues in Q3 (service 24%).
quarterly_data.figure: Vacuum Technique orders MSEK 16 659 (+87%); Asia/Oceania 67% of its orders; revenues MSEK 12 257

quarterly_data.quarter: Atlas Copco IR presentation: quarterly report (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 quarterly report, Group and other business areas: nine-month orders MSEK 148 684 (+17%, organic +18%); sequentially, organic order volumes 'remained essentially unchanged'. Compressor Technique orders MSEK 20 418; gas and process compressor orders grew strongly in North America and Europe but decreased in Asia and Africa/Middle East; it launched TVD22-29 air-cooled fluid coolers. Industrial Technique automotive orders decreased sequentially on lower demand in Europe and Asia. Power Technique orders MSEK 8 411 (+25%). After period end, on October 2, 2026, Atlas Copco acquired 100% of Euroklimat Air-Conditioning & Refrigeration Co., Ltd., a Chinese manufacturer of industrial heating and cooling solutions (process cooling, energy conversion) with revenues of about BSEK 1.8 in 2025 and about 1 000 employees, now part of the Oil-free Air division of Compressor Technique. Employees: 57 147 (55 840). Middle East revenues were less than 4% of Group revenues in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: nine-month orders MSEK 148 684 (+17%); Euroklimat revenues about BSEK 1.8 (2025); 57 147 employees
